Tactical Breakdown: Argentina 3 (4) - (2) 3 France. Argentina's tactical setup under Lionel Scaloni prioritized overwhelming France's right flank. By placing Di Maria wide on the left, Argentina isolated Jules Koundé. Rodrigo De Paul and Nahuel Molina covered the right flank defensive duties, limiting Kylian Mbappé's space during the first 75 minutes.

Statistical Analysis: Argentina generated 3.30 total xG compared to France's 2.25 xG (including penalties). In open play, Argentina controlled 62% of progressive passes and forced 18 high turnovers in France's defensive third. Enzo Fernández completed 10 passes into the final third while making 11 defensive pressures.

France's tactical response in the 41st minute shifted their formation from 4-3-3 to 4-2-4, utilizing Marcus Thuram and Randal Kolo Muani as physical outlets to bypass Argentina's midfield press. This structural shift eventually paid dividends when Kolo Muani won the penalty in the 79th minute.
